adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `uniqueGuests` is computed with a case-sensitive check `!booking.attendees.some((attendee) => guest === attendee.email)`. Since `guests` comes from `z.string().email()` (no normalization) and nothing lowercases `guest` or `attendee.email`, a case-variant of an existing attendee (e.g., `Alice@x.com` vs `alice@x.com`) would not be filtered out and could be inserted via `createMany`, creating duplicate attendee records. This also affects email routing in `sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests)`, which uses `newGuests.includes(attendee.email)` (also case-sensitive), so case mismatches can lead to incorrect template selection.
